relationships.subject: Arnica montana
relationships.evidence_quote: These data showed the ability of A. montana (mother tincture and mainly 1C dilution) to significantly reduce TNFα production in inflamed macrophages compared with vehicle (control).

relationships.subject: Arnica montana
relationships.evidence_quote: They significantly reduced both IL-6 and MCP-1 in inflamed human microglial cells and significantly decreased COX-2 expression in inflamed murine fibroblasts.

relationships.subject: Arnica montana
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of ICAM-1 was significantly reduced with A. montana mother tincture and 1C, 3C, 5C, and 9C dilutions in inflamed human endothelial cells compared with vehicle.

key_findings: Arnica montana mother tincture and 1C dilution reduced TNFα, IL-6, MCP-1, COX-2, ICAM-1 and ROS in various cell models.
